key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: Special-category, private life, image and communications data of deceased protected; designated person or heirs may exercise access, rectification, erasure; deceased may forbid (art. 17)
research_exemption: Scientific/historical research must respect minimisation and anonymise or pseudonymise where possible (art. 31 per secondary sources; article not confirmed); GDPR art. 89 derogations (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; Law 12/2005 governs genetic information and biological samples for testing/research; health info of living or deceased only for care and health research
